description: This file defines the TagDao interface for database operations related to Tag entities in an Android app using Room Persistence Library.

classes.name: TagDao
classes.description: Data Access Object interface for performing database operations on Tag entities.

methods.name: insert
methods.description: Inserts a Tag into the database, ignoring conflicts, and returns the new row ID.

methods.name: update
methods.description: Updates one or more Tag entities in the database.

methods.name: delete
methods.description: Deletes one or more Tag entities from the database.

methods.name: getAll
methods.description: Retrieves all Tag entries as a reactive Flow stream.

methods.name: getById
methods.description: Retrieves a Tag by its ID as a reactive Flow stream.

methods.name: getByName
methods.description: Retrieves a Tag by its name as a reactive Flow stream.
